Reservoir-oriented outdoor recreation facilities would not be developed at this site due to weekly 160-foot fluctuations in the surface elevation required for reservoir operation. Off-site recreation development would be required.
The extent of adverse impacts on recreational resources caused by construction of this alternative is not known to the FPC Staff. Operation of this alternative reservoir would have impacts upon recreation at Lake Jocassee similar to those resulting from the proposed Bad Creek Project, as described in Subsection 3.2.1.
8.3.2.6 Socio-Economic Considerations
Similar to Bad Creek and the other two alternative sites, Bearcamp Creek is located in a remote mountainous area, away from any resident population or businesses, and thus the development of a project here would not require the relocation of either persons or businesses.
